id.description: Repository id used in Maven repository configuration
id.title: Id

title.description: The title displayed on the frontend homepage.
title.title: Title

description.description:
The description displayed on the frontend homepage.
Note: HTML tags are not supported.
description.title: Description

privacyPolicy.description: Link to your privacy policy displayed in the footer. Useful for EU GDPR compliance.
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy

icpLicense.description:
Web services in China require ICP license, a permit issued by the Chinese government to permit China-based websites to operate in China.
In order to fulfill the conditions, you should apply for ICP license from your service provider and fill in this parameter.
icpLicense.title: ICP License

appearance.description: Colours, logos, favicon and footer of the dashboard.
appearance.title: Appearance

seedColor.description:
Hex colour in the form #RRGGBB that the dashboard palette is derived from.
Leave empty to keep the built-in Ingot theme.
seedColor.title: Seed colour

schemeVariant.description: How the palette is derived from the seed colour. Only applies when a seed colour is set.
schemeVariant.title: Scheme variant

primaryColor.description: Hex colour in the form #RRGGBB that overrides the primary key colour. Leave empty to derive it.
primaryColor.title: Primary colour

secondaryColor.description: Hex colour in the form #RRGGBB that overrides the secondary key colour. Leave empty to derive it.
secondaryColor.title: Secondary colour

tertiaryColor.description: Hex colour in the form #RRGGBB that overrides the tertiary key colour. Leave empty to derive it.
tertiaryColor.title: Tertiary colour

errorColor.description: Hex colour in the form #RRGGBB that overrides the error key colour. Leave empty to derive it.
errorColor.title: Error colour

logoDark.description: Link to a logo shown in the dark theme. Leave empty to use the organisation logo.
logoDark.title: Logo for dark theme

favicon.description: Link to the favicon of the dashboard. Leave empty to use the bundled favicon.
favicon.title: Favicon

footerText.description: Plain text shown in the footer of the dashboard. HTML is not rendered.
footerText.title: Footer text
